fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on proposals to divide Florida and grievances over South Florida taxation and state spending; questions and criticism regarding prohibition raids, gambling enforcement, and law enforcement practices; discussion of railroad rate reductions and their impact on Miami commerce and agriculture; notes on real estate conditions including foreclosures and contract cancellations; Community Chest and local charity efforts; sports coverage (golf and boxing) and assorted local columns, advertisements, and legal notices.
